expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Full component with state management, archiveDocuments, deleteDocuments, fetchDocuments, pagination, and styled table

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Complete TSX implementation with hooks, event handlers, conditional rendering, and full UI

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Implements inline confirmation prompt with Cancel/Confirm buttons; no soft-delete, trash, undo, or recovery mechanism beyond the confirmation dialog

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: Displays '{selectedIds.size} selected' and conditionally shows 'of {data.total} total' when selected < total

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Shows distinction via 'of {data.total} total' when count differs from page selection; makes clear that select-all toggles page items only

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive is white with blue border; Delete is red (bg-red-600); spatially separated in button row

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Archive appears first; Delete is second; confirmation requires additional interaction

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Final line: 'Replace the fetch URLs and mutation functions with your actual API/tRPC/GraphQL layer' — no note about server-side enforcement

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Closes with implementation detail about replacing fetch functions, not misuses prevented
